adBlockDns.note: Encrypted AdGuard DNS (free) blocks ad and tracker domains for every app. Turn off in BAKA Settings > System or with Restore BAKA System Tuning; the previous DNS servers come back.

note: Windows 11 Pro retains required diagnostic data (AllowTelemetry 0 is honored only on Enterprise/Education/Server). BAKA disables the telemetry upload service and tasks in SystemTuning.json, turns off ads, suggestions, Copilot, Recall, web search in Start, and activity history. This configuration does not claim zero telemetry. All values are backed up and restorable.
